title: Kernel switchboard: runtime conductor for mixed-format (FP16/FP8/INT8) dispatch
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: We need a centralized runtime component ("kernel switchboard") that deterministically selects an execution kernel for each request across heterogeneous precision variants (FP16, FP8, INT8). Current heuristics are ad-hoc per-model and cause inconsistent latency/quality trade-offs, unexpected rollbacks, and manual firmware of per-model policies.

Goal: Ship a lightweight, auditable conductor that uses calibration-derived quantization profiles, per-layer accuracy budgets, and micro-benchmark telemetry to select a kernel path at request time. It must support: per-layer/sequence-length routing, shadow validation for rollouts, automatic fallback to safer kernels on accuracy or latency regressions, and low-overhead runtime evaluation.

Scope: Implement the switchboard logic in the serving runtime and control-plane config: (1) accept quant_profile metadata and per-layer accuracy buckets produced by the calibration pipeline, (2) compute a composite score for candidate kernels (estimated latency cost + expected quality delta + confidence penalty), (3) select kernel and runtime config, (4) support shadow runs and telemetry collection for continuous validation.

Non-goals: Not covering offline retraining, not implementing new quantization schemes here. The switchboard relies on outputs from the calibration/quant pipeline (separate PRs).
acceptance_criteria: Runtime produces deterministic kernel choice given the same request attributes and quant_profile
End-to-end median tail latency change for mixed-precision path <= +5% compared to FP16 baseline for target models under typical load
Shadow validation pipeline runs on a configurable sample of requests and reports no accuracy degradation >0.5% (target metric) before expanding rollout
Automatic fallback triggers within 2 minutes of observed accuracy/latency regression beyond thresholds
Telemetry shows per-layer selection distribution, per-kernel latency histograms, and per-model accuracy deltas available in Console Dashboard
Integration tests cover per-layer gating, fallback path, and canary rollout automation
implementation_steps: Design scoring function: normalized latency estimate + quality delta penalty + confidence margin (weight params exposed via config)
Add switchboard module in runtime: candidate discovery, scoring, deterministic tie-break rules, and logging hooks
Consume quant_profile metadata: per-layer quant type, calibration error estimates, per-layer sensitivity ranks
Wire shadow-run plumbing: request duplication for sampled traffic, compact similarity hashing to pair outputs for comparison
Add per-request annotations for observability: selected_path_id, score_breakdown, fallback_reason
Create canary workflow: sample fraction config, thresholds, automated promotion/rollback steps in control plane
End-to-end perf tests with microbench harness and latency/throughput regression suite
Run model-level accuracy validation using stored prompt sets; integrate results into rollout gating
telemetry_requirements: Per-layer selection counts and top-k selected kernel variants
Shadow-run divergence rate and per-asset accuracy delta
Real-time alerts for spike in fallback rate or divergence rate
Retention: 90 days for rollouts and 365 days for incidents (configurable)
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (dev): unit tests and local microbench for 3 representative models
Phase 1 (shadow): 0% production traffic, 100% shadow sampled at 5% of requests; validate divergence and latency impact over 72 hours
Phase 2 (canary): 5% live traffic with switchboard active; monitor for 48 hours; automated rollback on trigger
Phase 3 (gradual): ramp to 25% then 100% with progressive threshold tightening; each step gated by accuracy and latency metrics
Safety net: global 'disable-switchboard' toggle and per-customer override to force FP16 or model-specific policy
test_plan: Unit tests for scoring math, deterministic ordering, tie-breakers
Integration tests that simulate dynamic sequence lengths and per-layer quant profiles
Shadow-run validator comparing logits or decoded tokens using fuzzy-match thresholds
Load tests to verify tail latency under batching and KV cache warm-start
Regression harness reproducing previous failures in historical incidents (see incident-2024-11-03)
